Center lies on x = 3, so the center is (3, k). The radius squared is 1 + k².

The distance from (3, k) to the line y = x is |3 − k|/√2, so the squared distance is (3 − k)²/2.

Tangency requires (3 − k)²/2 = 1 + k².

Then (3 − k)² = 2 + 2k², so 9 − 6k + k² = 2 + 2k², which gives k² + 6k − 7 = 0.

The roots are k = 1 and k = −7, and the sum of the roots is −6.

ANSWER: -6
